Backend allowlist for the LLM model id merchants send (brief B1).
Exploit: controllers/langGraphController.js:66 takes payload.aiModel as any string; services/openAi.service.js:42 resolveModel passes unknown ids straight to OpenRouter, so a free-plan merchant sends aiModel:'openai/o1-pro' and gets billed the same credits (credits = completion tokens, model-agnostic) while we pay 30-240x. FE gates gpt-5.2 by hasGpt5Access (packages/assets/src/helpers/hasGpt5Access.js:7) only.

- Use it everywhere a model id is read from the request body, before any isOutOfTokens/isLegacyMiniUnlimited/reduceTokens call so billing sees the resolved id: langGraphController.js:66, genAIBlogController.js:46 and :144 (and :405 if it is a text model id), blogAssist.controller.js:93, toolsYouTubeController.js:102. Each controller already loads the shop or can via getShopById(getCurrentShop(ctx)).

- Tests: packages/functions/src/helpers/__tests__/allowedTextModel.test.js (allowed ids pass; 'openai/o1-pro' -> undefined; gpt-5.2 on free plan -> undefined, on pro or isUseGPT5 -> 'gpt-5.2'); and extend controllers/__tests__/genAIBlogController.tokenDeduction.test.js or add one asserting a forged aiModel never reaches the service.
